# The Aldera

> The Aldera is a U.S. dietary supplement brand distributed by 518 GROUP LLC (7901 4th St N, Suite 300, St. Petersburg, FL 33702). Its format is the 30-Day Pass: one foil sachet holds two vegetable capsules, one full day's serving, and each box holds 30 sachets. Every batch is tested by an independent laboratory, and the QR code on the box opens the report for that lot. Tagline: "Daily care. To go." Selling on thealdera.com and TikTok Shop; launching soon.

## Lineup (amounts per sachet, two capsules; $29.99 per 30-Day Pass)
### First wave
- Magnesium Bisglycinate: 200 mg elemental magnesium, fully reacted chelate, no magnesium oxide
- Ashwagandha: 600 mg root extract
- Moringa: 1,000 mg leaf powder
- Shilajit: 500 mg purified shilajit, at least 20% fulvic acid
### Next wave
- Gut Balance: 10 billion CFU probiotic, 8 strains, with digestive enzymes
- Sea Moss: 1,000 mg sea moss, bladderwrack and burdock root
- Lion's Mane: 1,000 mg fruiting body extract
- Hair, Skin & Nails: 5,000 mcg biotin with vitamin C and hyaluronic acid
